prompts.small: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an upload-ready Chrome Web Store promotional graphic for Kasten, an independent self-custody Kaspa wallet published by GHOSTDAGGER. Reference image 1 is the actual existing Kasten app icon, supplied ONLY as a brand/logo reference; preserve its identity, proportions, teal keyhole plate, dark vault face, two pale left hinges, rounded inset door and corner rivets. Do not invent a new logo. Premium restrained software identity matching an established website: deep forest background #0b1512, cream #f0f2e9, mint #9de7bd, teal #0FB894. Opaque full-bleed background, subtle forest gradient and controlled soft glow behind icon, clean Inter-like sans-serif typography, generous spacing. No browser chrome, no UI screenshots, no QR codes, no cryptocurrency coin illustration, no balances, no security guarantees, no badges, no rating stars, no call-to-action button, no extra copy, no borders or external mockup. Exact spelling of brand: "kasten" (k-a-s-t-e-n), lowercase. Exact tagline: "Your Kaspa." and "Your keys." Cream first sentence, mint second. Asset: small promo tile, final export 440 x 280, landscape aspect ratio exactly 11:7. Generate at 1760 x 1120 if possible, or exactly proportional. Compose for excellent legibility after reduction to 440 x 280. Upper-left small brand row with the existing icon and wordmark "kasten". Below it a large bold two-line tagline "Your Kaspa." then "Your keys.". The brand icon may also appear as a larger subtly tilted vault on the right if it does not compete with the typography; prefer one clear logo rather than repetition. All copy must be large and readable, 24px safe margin at final size. No other text.
